questions.exp: Alexander Graham Bell is credited with inventing the telephone and patenting it in 1876. However, Antonio Meucci is also credited with developing the first voice communication device in 1854.
Penicillin, the first antibiotic, was discovered by Alexander Fleming in 1928 when he noticed that mold (Penicillium notatum) was killing bacteria in a petri dish.
GPS stands for Global Positioning System. It is a satellite-based navigation system owned by the US government. It provides location and time information anywhere on or near the Earth.

questions.q: The World Wide Web was invented by?
questions.exp: Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web (WWW) in 1989 while working at CERN. He also developed the first web browser (WorldWideWeb) and the HTTP protocol.

questions.q: Which country launched the world's first artificial satellite?
questions.exp: The Soviet Union (USSR) launched the world's first artificial satellite, Sputnik 1, on 4 October 1957. This event marked the beginning of the Space Age.

questions.q: The full form of AI in technology is?
questions.exp: AI stands for Artificial Intelligence. It refers to the simulation of human intelligence processes by computer systems, including learning, reasoning, and self-correction.

questions.q: Wi-Fi technology uses which type of waves?
questions.exp: Wi-Fi uses radio waves (typically 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz frequencies) to transmit data wirelessly. It is based on the IEEE 802.11 standards and allows devices to connect to the internet wirelessly.

questions.q: The silicon chip was invented by?
questions.exp: Jack Kilby of Texas Instruments invented the integrated circuit (silicon chip) in 1958. He was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2000 for this invention.

questions.q: The first successful heart transplant was performed by?
questions.exp: Dr. Christiaan Barnard performed the world's first successful human heart transplant on 3 December 1967 at Groote Schuur Hospital in Cape Town, South Africa.

questions.q: 5G technology primarily uses which frequency band?
questions.exp: 5G technology uses multiple frequency bands including Sub-6 GHz (for wider coverage) and millimeter wave (mmWave) bands (24-100 GHz, for extremely high speeds). It offers speeds up to 100 times faster than 4G.
